title: Returns policy
content: Unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items damaged in transit must be reported within 48 hours of delivery with photos, and are replaced or refunded within 60 days. Used tents are not accepted for return except under warranty.

title: Warranty policy
content: Tents carry a five-year warranty against seam failures and pole defects. Sleeping bags carry a two-year warranty on zippers and baffles. Normal wear, UV damage and damage caused by improper storage are not covered.

title: Shipping policy
content: Orders over 100 USD ship free and arrive in three to five business days. Tents and other oversize items ship by freight and need a signature at delivery. Express shipping costs 25 USD.

title: Price match policy
content: If a product is listed lower at another authorized retailer within 14 days of purchase, Contoso Outdoor refunds the difference. Clearance and bundle prices are excluded.

title: Repair service
content: Contoso Outdoor repairs seams and zippers free of charge during the first year after purchase. After the first year, repairs cost 15 to 40 USD depending on the damage, and the tent warranty still applies to seam failures.

title: Gift cards
content: Gift cards never expire and can be used online and in stores. Gift cards cannot be redeemed for cash, and lost cards cannot be replaced without proof of purchase.
